message: King of Chu, I welcome this alliance as Qin's shadow looms large over both our kingdoms. By standing together, we can secure our borders and prevent further Qin encroachment into Central China. Let us formalize this pact immediately to ensure mutual security against their northern ambitions.
reasoning: Qin is the dominant power threatening Han's core territory at Zheng with 5 SCs compared to my 2. An alliance with Chu secures the southern flank and leverages Chu's resources against Qin, giving Han breathing room to survive until the late game.
